<commits>
e39993193c doc: fix incorrect @param annotations

c182b8005e doc: use doxygen comments for blocks containing @param

Plain /* comments are ignored by Doxygen and by clang's -Wdocumentation,
so mistakes in them go unnoticed. Also wrap the CoinGrinder ASCII trees
in @verbatim so Doxygen keeps their layout.

2c8c91c5a0 build: enable -Wdocumentation-unknown-command

Catches misspelled doxygen commands such as '@peer[in]' (for
'@param[in]'), which -Wdocumentation alone does not report. i.e

```bash
../src/net_processing.cpp:717:8: warning: unknown command tag name [-Wdocumentation-unknown-command]
  717 |      * @peer[in] peer     The peer whose orphan transactions we will reconsider. Generally only
      |        ^~~~~
1 warning generated.
```
</commits>
